question: How do suppliers register and bid for procurement tenders through the URA Procurement Management System (PMS)?
answer: Suppliers intending to provide goods, services, or civil works to the Uganda Revenue Authority must register on the online Procurement Management System (PMS) at https://ura.go.ug/en/opportunities/tenders/procurement-management-system/. The PMS portal enables prospective bidders to: 1) Register as a verified corporate supplier by submitting company incorporation documents, valid Tax Clearance Certificate (TCC), National Social Security Fund (NSSF) clearance, and bank details; 2) Browse active public tenders, expressions of interest (EOIs), and requests for quotations (RFQs); 3) Submit digital bid documents before tender closing deadlines; 4) Access the official user manual 'Help for Sourcing Suppliers' (965 KB PDF) downloadable at https://ura.go.ug/download-category/tender-user-manuals/.

question: How does the URA Online Public Auctioning Application work for seized, overtime, and abandoned goods?
answer: URA operates an automated digital public auctioning application at https://ura.go.ug/en/opportunities/auctions/auctioning-application/ (also accessible via singlewindow.go.ug/auction) for the disposal of overtime cargo, uncleared customs goods, seized contraband, and decommissioned URA board assets: 1) Account Registration: Bidders register online with an active 10-digit TIN, National ID (NIN) or passport, and contact phone/email; 2) Viewing: Bidders physically inspect cataloged auction lots at designated customs warehouses (e.g. Nakawa, Malaba, Busia) during gazetted pre-bid viewing days; 3) Online Bidding: Bidders submit competitive electronic bids during the active auction window; 4) Payment & Clearance: Successful bidders receive an assessment notice and PRN to pay the winning bid amount plus statutory taxes within 48 to 72 hours, followed by warehouse release; 5) User Manual: Download 'AUCTION PLATFORM FOR URA ASSETS RVD' (2 MB PDF) at https://ura.go.ug/download-category/user-guides/.

question: What career and e-learning opportunities are offered by URA?
answer: Under URA Opportunities at https://ura.go.ug/en/opportunities/: 1) Careers: Competitive recruitment for graduate trainees, experienced professionals, CCFL (Commissioner Customs Fast-Track Licensing) programs, and university internships; 2) URA E-Learning Platform: Provides digital taxation courses, customs clearance tutorials, and taxpayer education modules accessible to the public and tax practitioners; 3) Supplier Opportunities: Procurement opportunities published periodically under PPDA guidelines at https://ura.go.ug/en/opportunities/tenders/.
